description: WSO2 SAP Successfactors Dismissal Protection provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsEmployeeCentral/overview). The service allows to manage dismissal protection information for employees, ensuring compliance with labor laws and regulations.
key-features: Manage dismissal protection records and legal compliance
Track termination documentation and regulatory requirements
Query protection details and compliance status
